run_findings.pre_handle_protocol_families: NEW: distinguish server-minted post-create handles, client-minted stable create identity, and preflight continuation-before-effect. Only the latter two can close first-response-loss without blind duplicate creation, and only with exact verification/atomic keyed creation.
run_findings.mcp_jsonrpc_id: BLOCKED_AS_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: current MCP JSON-RPC request id is correlation identity; SEP-1050 MRTR retries use a different request id.
run_findings.mcp_request_state: PARTIAL_BY_DEFAULT: requestState is server-issued continuation state and may be integrity-bound to method/args/principal, but it exists only after receipt. A no-effect preflight followed by durable atomic create-or-get keyed by a stable operation identity can convert it into a recoverable creation fence; stock Tasks does not provide the keyed store automatically.
run_findings.kubernetes_create_or_verify: PROVED_PATTERN: deterministic metadata.name plus stable intent/ownership verification makes response-loss recovery possible via GET same name; UID detects delete/recreate and resourceVersion protects later read-modify-write. generateName is a counterexample.
run_findings.openhands_unique_descendant: PARTIAL_BRANCH_INTENT: a unique descendant chain is structurally useful but does not prove active-branch intent in a fork-capable log.
run_findings.openhands_fenced_commit_marker: SOURCE_DESIGN: durable pending marker under ConversationLease generation + expected old leaf + exact event parent/hash can encode active-head intent and let takeover finish/clear only verified states; conflicts fail closed. Scope is supported local-filesystem durability only and existing unmatched Action repair stays separate.
run_findings.control25_acceptance: Control24's blanket zero-residual-executor positive oracle is stale. This run exhausted current Chat-capable research and role-local persistence; no generic protected residual effect is asserted for this leaf.
